texts.policyTailoringTime: Standard Custom Tailoring & Suits takes 1–3 weeks. Express takes 2–3 days, subject to feasibility and capacity confirmation. Measurements, fabric/material availability, fittings and operational requirements may affect completion. Your actual completion date is agreed before order acceptance; a requested deadline is not automatically accepted. The actual production period starts with the official production-start notice, not the initial enquiry date.
texts.policyAlterationTime: Standard Clothing Alterations & Repairs takes 12–15 working hours; Express takes 2–12 working hours, subject to inspection, feasibility and capacity. Working hours are not consecutive clock hours or calendar days. The actual completion date is confirmed before acceptance.
texts.policyCareTime: Standard Garment Care & Cleaning takes approximately 3 days. Express garment care takes 2–12 hours, subject to confirmation, garment assessment and available capacity. No stain-removal or fabric-outcome guarantee is given. The actual completion date is agreed before acceptance.
texts.policyCharges: Express adds 35% of the eligible quoted base service. Necessary and agreed after-hours work from 17:00 to 22:00 Kigali time adds 25% of the same eligible base. When both apply, the additive surcharge is 60%, not compounded. Charges are shown separately in the quotation for your agreement. Work after 22:00 requires an individual quotation and payment arrangement; there is no universal overnight percentage. Ordinary-service percentages are not automatically added to an individually agreed VIP quotation.
texts.policyChargeExample: Calculation examples for an eligible 100,000 RWF base: Express totals 135,000 RWF; after-hours totals 125,000 RWF; both total 160,000 RWF. These illustrate the calculation, not a universal service price. No after-hours charge applies automatically if after-hours work is not needed and agreed.
texts.policyDomesticPayment: Ordinary domestic custom garment orders normally require a 70% advance before official work begins and the remaining 30% before release or delivery, unless a different approved arrangement is confirmed in the quotation. For standard suits, the balance is due after tailoring completion and before final cleaning and delivery. Full payment must be confirmed before garment release. Standard standalone services normally require a 70% advance before official work begins and the remaining 30% before release or delivery, unless a different approved arrangement is confirmed in the quotation. The suit-specific final-cleaning sequence does not apply automatically. Mobile assistance, consultations and VIP arrangements follow their applicable agreed terms. Payment screenshots alone do not establish receipt.
texts.policyInternationalPayment: International custom orders require feasibility confirmation, quotation acceptance and 100% of the agreed quotation before production. Shipping and other applicable charges must be clearly quoted. No fixed international shipping cost or delivery time is promised without verified arrangements.
texts.policyPaymentVerification: Payment verification applies to domestic and international customers. Workplace cash payments must be received, recorded and acknowledged. Bank transfers and Mobile Money require verification of actual receipt; screenshots alone do not prove cleared funds, and pending transactions are not completed payments. After verification, customers receive payment confirmation and the appropriate next steps. For eligible domestic Standard tailoring, an individually approved lower advance is subject to its agreed three-calendar-day full-payment deadline. Verification alone is not the official production-start notice: required order conditions and the separate approved production-start process still apply. Use verified instructions and protect PINs and account credentials. Payments are acknowledged after receipt is verified. A payment screenshot or pending transaction is not confirmation of receipt. A proforma invoice or payment request is not a substitute for an official tax invoice where required under applicable law.
texts.policyTransport: Eligible Kigali alterations and garment-care orders have a 10,000 RWF total collection-and-return charge for the round trip. The same order combining alterations and cleaning is not charged twice. Customer drop-off, professional visits, included initial Kigali custom-suit delivery and international shipping are different arrangements. Location eligibility and any separate arrangement are confirmed in the quotation; no nationwide delivery price is implied.
texts.policyMobileMeasurement: Order-related Measurement Visit: 10,000 RWF for an eligible Kigali visit after you accept the garment quotation and pay the required 70% garment advance. It is separate from an independent consultation; do not pay both visit fees for the same approved measurement service. Choosing a visit preference does not require payment or confirm an appointment.
texts.policyMobileConsultation: Independent Consultation & Fitting: 35,000 RWF for customers without a confirmed garment order who request professional measurement, fitting, garment-selection or planning assistance. This is a separately purchased service. Location, scope and appointment require confirmation; choosing an appointment preference alone does not require payment.
texts.policyMobileAssistance: Independent Tailoring Assistance: 50,000 RWF for the agreed independent tailoring, styling or event-assistance scope, up to five people and three hours. Exceeding either limit requires VIP assessment and an individually revised quotation. Confirm location eligibility and any travel arrangements before agreement.
texts.policyVIP: VIP assistance is individually quoted for individual, family, event or group needs across tailoring, alterations, garment care and mobile/styling assistance. The quotation considers group size, time, location, service complexity and operational requirements. Standard mobile assistance exceeding five people or three hours needs VIP assessment. Scope, feasibility, payment arrangements and service confirmation must be agreed. No universal VIP price, unlimited service, free benefit, membership payment or guaranteed response time is promised. Approved VIP Express and after-hours assistance is addressed within the agreed VIP quotation.
texts.policyOwnFabric: You may ask us to assess fabric you supply. Suitability, quantity, condition, design and any additional materials are checked before a quotation and acceptance. A reference photograph does not promise exact replication, exact fabric or colour availability. Alternatives and quotation changes require your agreement. Customer-supplied fabric does not automatically carry a blanket liability exclusion or refund forfeiture.
texts.policyFourDays: Four days is normally longer than the published Standard alterations estimate of 12–15 working hours. Inspection, operating hours, fittings and confirmed capacity still determine the agreed completion date. Mentioning a four-day deadline does not automatically require Express service or an Express fee.
texts.policyShopEnquiry: Choose a Shop product to view its details, then enquire on WhatsApp. Our team confirms available options, the final amount, and delivery or collection arrangements before payment. An enquiry does not reserve stock or confirm a purchase. Mobile Money, Bank Transfer and Cryptocurrency are manually arranged payment options; wait for verified instructions. No automatic payment gateway is activated.
texts.policyChildren: We make custom clothing for children, including children aged two, after confirming design, measurements and production requirements. Children’s ordinary suit starting prices follow the corresponding Tier / Quality schedule.
texts.policyParentChild: Children younger than 12 automatically receive 50% off each eligible ordinary suit when the same order includes at least one adult suit charged at its normal applicable price. The offer applies across all tiers and quality levels. Without an adult suit, children’s suits use the normal corresponding suit price. Customer discounts do not stack on the same suit; no separate promotional approval is required.
texts.policyBulk: For two or more qualifying suits in one order, the highest-priced qualifying suit remains at its regular price and the second and subsequent qualifying suits receive 3% off. This is not 3% off every suit and does not cover unrelated services. Customer discounts do not stack on the same suit; use the highest eligible customer discount. The quotation identifies qualifying items; no automatic discount engine is active.
texts.policyTierExplanation: Tier 1 / Quality 1 through Tier 4 / Quality 4 are ordinary suit pricing and collection categories with different included benefits. Fabrics have assigned tiers, and several fabrics may share a tier. Read the Fabric Guide for reference classifications; final fabric and design requirements are reviewed in the quotation.
texts.policyProductionStart: The actual production period begins when Mr Sewing Fashion issues the official production-start notice, after the required order steps are complete. An enquiry date, provider acknowledgement, quotation or payment screenshot does not start the production countdown. Quotation acceptance, verified required payment, final requirements and official order confirmation remain separate steps.
texts.policyDeadlineAssessment: For ordinary custom suits, the website provisionally screens your requested deadline using: requested completion date and time minus the current time minus a 24-hour planning allowance. Seven days or more of remaining planning time is Standard; less than seven days is Express. This is not a confirmed production schedule or an automatic surcharge. Mr Sewing must assess feasibility, capacity and applicable charges with your agreement. Special Tailoring needs garment-specific human assessment; the ordinary-suit threshold is not applied blindly.
texts.policyStandardTailoring: Standard Tailoring follows the normal assessed production arrangements and the completion date agreed for your order. The ordinary-suit website screening treats seven days or more of planning time, after a 24-hour allowance, as provisionally Standard. This screening is not a promise to complete a suit in seven days. The actual production period starts with the official production-start notice.
texts.policyExpressTailoring: Express Tailoring is priority work subject to feasibility, capacity and an agreed completion date. An ordinary-suit deadline with less than seven days of planning time after the 24-hour allowance is screened as Express. Contact Mr Sewing directly or continue the quotation request for assessment. The approved eligible Express surcharge is 35%, separately quoted and agreed; screening does not automatically add a fee or accept the deadline.
texts.policyCustomerDelays: Delays in replying, accepting a quotation, confirming measurements or satisfying agreed requirements can affect completion arrangements. If the time remaining later requires Express handling, the team must reassess availability, the completion date and applicable charges. No Express fee is added automatically without assessment and customer agreement.
texts.policyQuotationTargets: For Custom Tailoring, we target a quotation within 24 hours for Express and within 24–48 hours for Standard, subject to operating hours, sufficient information and assessment requirements. These are targets, not unconditional guarantees. Provider acceptance, a first human reply, quotation delivery, quotation acceptance, order confirmation and the official production-start notice are separate events. If the communicated period passes without a response, use the official WhatsApp or telephone contact.
texts.policyMeasurementAppointments: Choose a visit to Mr Sewing, a requested visit to your location, or online measurements in your tailoring enquiry. A visit request includes a preferred date and time; a customer-location visit also needs its address and relevant access details. The team confirms location, scope, availability and any applicable fee before the appointment is accepted.
texts.policyMeasurementLocations: Main Workshop: KN 441 St, Norvège, Kigali. Downtown Consultation Location: MIC Building, by appointment. Confirm the location, date and time with the team before travelling.
texts.policyOnlineMeasurements: You may use the existing Measurements Guide and provide measurements online for review. Unless an agreed service requirement says otherwise, you do not need to complete measurement submission before an initial quotation. Preserve your quotation selections while reviewing the guide; the team will confirm the measurements and fitting requirements for your garment.
texts.policyCustomDelivery: Initial delivery within Kigali, Rwanda is included for eligible custom-suit packages and is not charged again. A Kigali delivery address is optional when you submit the enquiry, but the team must confirm it before dispatch. For eligible Custom Tailoring orders delivered elsewhere in Rwanda, the delivery amount is 5,000 RWF per garment: one garment 5,000 RWF, two 10,000 RWF, three 15,000 RWF. A delivery address is required outside Kigali. This calculated amount is not a final accepted quotation and does not automatically apply to Alterations or Garment Care. International delivery requires a complete address and an individually assessed shipping quotation; no universal price or transit time is promised. If you collect, choose a preferred collection location instead of entering a delivery address; the team must confirm collection arrangements.
texts.policyKigaliDelivery: Initial delivery within Kigali, Rwanda is included in an eligible custom-suit package. It is not charged a second time. Your full delivery address is optional at enquiry submission, but must be confirmed before dispatch. Other services and transport arrangements keep their own applicable terms.
texts.policyOutsideKigaliDelivery: For eligible Custom Tailoring delivery elsewhere in Rwanda, the calculated amount is 5,000 RWF per garment. For example, one garment is 5,000 RWF, two are 10,000 RWF and three are 15,000 RWF. A delivery address is required. The team confirms the complete quotation and arrangements; this rate is not automatically applied to Alterations or Garment Care.
texts.policyCustomerCollection: You may request collection and choose a preferred collection location. A delivery address is not required for collection. Wait for the team to confirm the location, readiness and collection arrangements; full payment is still required before release.
texts.policySubmissionConfirmation: Submitting the website form requests human quotation review. It does not accept an order, confirm an appointment, confirm payment or accept the requested completion date. A verified positive submission-provider response supports an acknowledgement only; it does not establish staff inbox receipt or completed human review.
texts.policyExpressRecovery: When you choose Express WhatsApp or Call Us, the website can save a same-browser recovery snapshot of garment references, quantities, fabric/colour preferences, requested deadline and country/city, with a 24-hour expiry checked when you return. It does not deliberately save contact fields, full addresses or free-form additional information in this recovery snapshot, and it does not reopen a closed browsing-selection session. Browser storage may be unavailable or cleared; it does not provide cross-device recovery or recovery after browser data is deleted.
texts.policyFlexibleAdvance: For eligible domestic Standard custom tailoring orders, customers unable to pay the usual 70% advance may request an individually agreed lower initial payment. This is not an automatic entitlement. Production may begin only when operationally and financially feasible and the applicable order conditions are confirmed. The entire outstanding balance must be paid within three calendar days of the initial payment, even if the garment is not yet finished. The initial amount, remaining balance and exact deadline must be communicated and accepted. This exception is not available for Express orders and does not automatically apply to international orders, mobile assistance, consultations or VIP arrangements.
texts.policyExpressAdvance: For domestic Express tailoring, the normal 70% advance applies to the total agreed quotation, including the 35% Express surcharge and any other charges included in that quotation. The remaining 30% is due at completion, before release, subject to applicable final-cleaning arrangements. Express deadlines are agreed individually; the below-70% exception does not apply.
texts.policyOverdueAdvance: Under an agreed exceptional advance arrangement, production is suspended if the full outstanding balance is not paid by the three-calendar-day deadline. We notify the customer of the overdue amount and its effect on the order. Payment must be settled before work resumes on an order that remains open; the completion date may need reassessment.
texts.policyRefundBeforeProduction: Before official production begins, the approved baseline for customer cancellation is a refund of amounts paid less genuine, documented, nonrecoverable order-specific costs, where those deductions were lawfully disclosed and are permitted by applicable law.
texts.policyRefundAfterProduction: Cancellations after work begins, standalone visits, garment-care processing, Shop orders and other special cases require assessment of the accepted order, work already completed, recoverable costs and applicable mandatory rights. No universal automatic forfeiture or non-refundable fee applies.
texts.policyOverdueCancellation: Suspension of an overdue exceptional-payment order does not itself mean cancellation or forfeiture. Any cancellation is assessed under the accepted order conditions, communicated to the customer and subject to applicable legal requirements. Work already performed and genuine, documented nonrecoverable order-specific costs may be considered only where lawfully disclosed and permitted. Restarting a cancelled order requires a new agreement.
texts.policyRefundAssessment: Refund amount, method and processing timetable are determined under the applicable agreed order conditions, approved refund policy and mandatory legal requirements.
